world_height_definition: Mala, 2026-10-31: "the raven should be about .25 the size of the normal sprite". A person (the Warden) = 1.0. The PNGs are drawn at person-scale resolution, so the game must draw the Raven at a quarter of a person's height.
source: Raven Pixel Sprite Sheet.png (claude-raven-cut-build, Anchor BD)
note: Nothing in web/combat reads size_class or world_height yet (the Neo Warden's size.json is the only precedent); the Raven familiar build wires the draw scale (claude-raven-familiar-spec section 2a).
